twilio:index:Address.description: A Twilio address. Deleting an address that is still used by a phone number, bundle or regulatory registration fails until it is released from them.

accountSid.description: SID of the account or subaccount that owns the address. Defaults to the provider account. Changing it replaces the resource.

autoCorrectAddress.description: Whether Twilio corrects the address on write (Twilio default true). Twilio does not return this setting. While it is not false, the address lines Twilio stores may differ from the inputs (normalized spelling and case), so they are not refreshed from Twilio; set it to false to have drift in the address lines detected. Because Twilio never returns it, an imported address has no value for it.

customerName.description: Name of the customer or business the address belongs to.

dateUpdated.description: When the address was last updated (RFC 2822).

emergencyEnabled.description: Whether the address is enabled for emergency calling. Twilio only accepts true for a validated address.

friendlyName.description: Human-readable name of the address (up to 64 characters for regulatory addresses, 32 otherwise). Removing it leaves the name unchanged on Twilio.

isoCountry.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example US. Twilio cannot change the country of an address, so changing it replaces the resource.

ownerAccountSid.description: SID of the account that owns the address.

sid.description: The address SID (AD...), usable as addressSid or emergencyAddressSid on a phone number.

streetSecondary.description: Second address line, for example a suite or floor.

twilio:index:ApiKey.description: A Twilio API key. The secret is available only in the creation response and is stored as a Pulumi secret. Creating and deleting keys requires the account auth token (an API key cannot manage keys).

accountSid.description: SID of the account or subaccount the key belongs to. Defaults to the provider account. Changing it replaces the resource. To import a key owned by a subaccount use the ID <accountSid>/<keySid>.

friendlyName.description: Human-readable name of the key (up to 64 characters).

keyType.description: standard (default; full access to the account's REST API except account and key management) or restricted (limited to the permissions in policy). Changing it replaces the resource.

policy.description: JSON policy document for a restricted key, for example {"allow":["/twilio/iam/api-keys/create"]}. Twilio only accepts assertions of the form /twilio/<product>/<resource>/<action>; a REST path such as /v1/Services/** is rejected with error 70002. Required when keyType is restricted and not allowed otherwise. Updated in place and read back on refresh, so a policy widened outside Pulumi is detected and reverted. Creating a restricted key lists the account's keys first; if Twilio creates the key and then fails the call, the new key with this friendlyName is deleted, so keep friendlyNames unique among keys created together.
